gt.heading: Getting to the sundial
gt.text:
To get to the level below the one where you spoke with Leela, you must use the stairs on the east side of the library, which has a patrolling guard, since the guard on the west side is stationary and right in front of the stairs. The walking range of the eastern guard is only between the two mesh dividers (visibility range is 5 tiles beyond that). On the next level down (the one above the sundial), the guards on both the north and south staircases are patrolling rather than stationary, but with a wider range than on the previous level. On this level, the visibility extends to the mesh screens, each of which is wider than on the previous level. The lowest level, with the sundial, doesn't have any guards.

It does not matter if Leela is seen by the guards, only you.

An easy way to get past the guards is to use the tables and chairs as markers. On the second level, from Leela, go east and then north. There is a guard patrolling the east side. You can go to the second table and stand next to it. Wait as the guard walks towards you, then, as he turns around, click to go down the stairs to the next level. 

On the third level, go south, where there is a guard patrolling. Stand near the corner, one tile south and two tiles east of the light, just beyond the table, and wait for the guard to approach, then as soon as he turns around, click the stairs to go down.

After going through all the guards in the Library and reaching the sundial, speak to Ozan, who leads you out an underwater passage to the southern beach of Sophanem. Go through the dialogue with Ozan and Leela, where you discuss what has happened so far and your plans. Leela is reluctant and feels bad about what she is going to do to her family. You can choose to tell her you are sorry or tell her that it doesn't matter how it feels; either option will work. Eventually, she and Ozan say that they are ready and to meet them at the throne room.

gt.heading: Getting there
gt.text:
Phoenix Lair is near the Piscatoris Fishing Colony. Players can get to the area by walking or one of these methods:
• Use the Phoenix Lair Teleport scroll obtained from Treasure Trails. It takes players to the entrance of the lair, and is very cheap at NoCoins | GE price | c . This is the fastest method to get to the lair.
• Teleport using the ability of the Mask of the Airut.
• Take the rowboat near the Eagles' Peak lodestone, west of the Tree Gnome Stronghold.
• Use fairy ring AKQ - Kandarin: Piscatoris Hunter area - (requires partial completion of A Fairy Tale II - Cure a Queen). The closest bank is northwest of the master fairy ring in Zanaris.
• Teleport to the Piscatoris Hunter area using a spirit kyatt's ability (requires Summoning level 57 and a spirit kyatt pouch).
• Use the teleport from memory strands located in the currency pouch and walk north. There is also a bank nearby.
• Teleport to the Piscatoris elder tree via the nature's sentinel outfit and then head west.
